summary.conditions: 8 m EDF of [124], 980 nm forward pump 18.1-114.9 mW, 40 x -13 dBm 1531-1562 nm; measured data digitized from arXiv:1803.07905v3 Fig. 8; model = spectrally resolved Giles model with forward and backward ASE unless stated; metrics over 40 channels x stated pump powers, model minus data
summary.design_target: 10.0 dB mean gain, 40 x -13 dBm, minimum peak-to-peak ripple

reference_data.description: Measured gain and ASE (0.1 nm resolution) of the EDFA of [124] (Perin et al., JLT 2019), Fig. 8, digitized from the vector graphics of arXiv:1803.07905; 40 channels at -13 dBm each, 980 nm forward pump, six pump powers. 'source_model' curves are the authors' own model predictions shown in the same figure.
reference_data.reference_plane: as reported by the source (not stated in detail; to be confirmed)

coef_scale.basis: common scale of alpha(lambda), g*(lambda), alpha_p; source: 'experimental error ... about 5%' ([124], App. A), taken as one standard deviation

ratio.basis: g*/alpha ratio; equivalent to +-1 nm in the McCumber crossing wavelength (assumed)

zeta.basis: saturation parameter (r_Er, N_t, tau 'approximately 10 ms'; assumed)

pump_dB.basis: pump power at the fiber input (assumed)

L4.method: least squares (scipy.optimize.least_squares); the PINN of Section 7.3 is not used
L4.second_rule: keep the second parameter only if formal sd < 0.02 and |corr| < 0.9 (calibration fit only)

L3.rule: minimize peak-to-peak gain ripple over the 40 channels at 10 dB mean gain (measurement plane); report pump power and maximum internal NF at that length
